notes: Native google-genai passthrough: request.json is the raw generateContent body a google-genai client sends to the gateway's /v1beta/models/{model}:{action} route; the adapter relays the upstream body untouched and the server bills from it with genaifmt.ExtractUsageMetadata / StreamUsageScanner (server/handlers_genai.go applyGenAIUsage). Streamed with streamGenerateContent?alt=sse: usageMetadata repeats on every chunk and the last carries the final counts; the signature rides on an empty text part in the final chunk (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/thought-signatures).
